name: Region Transparency Test
aliases: Fast Classification Algorithm with Summed Area Table
Min-max octree with summed area table
definition: A test using a min-max octree containing extrema of opacity function parameter values in each node (subcube of volume) to determine if a region is transparent.
summary: The Region Transparency Test accelerates volume rendering by skipping transparent regions using a min-max octree and summed area table, allowing interactive transfer function updates without rebuilding the volume structure.
